title: Adomba (brass cup bells)
summary: Cup-shaped brass bells hang from a carved bar. Each has an iron clapper that swings and knocks the lip; the bigger the bell, the deeper its ring.
howToPlay: Four bells are lit: Big, Medium, Small and Tiny.
Strike the bell a closing ring marks.
Shake each bell on the beat and let it ring.
rules: A stroke on the beat is perfect, a near one is good, and extra strokes cost points.
The round ends when the last stroke has been judged; the score is the share of the best possible.
heritageNote: A hand bell like an upturned cup, shaken so the clapper rings against its lip, keeps the time for groups at the coast.
credits: Tradition: the adomba cup bell of the Effutu of Winneba; patterns written for this game
